frontmatter_snapshot.summary: NK extends RBC with Calvo sticky prices so monetary shocks have short-run real effects; the three-equation DSGE workhorse pairs the dynamic IS (Euler equation), NK Phillips curve pi_t = beta E_t pi_{t+1} + kappa y-tilde_t derived from forward-looking Calvo pricing, and Taylor rule, yielding analytic impulse responses subject to the Taylor principle for determinacy.
